name: creator-project-os
title_zh: 把创作者的模糊灵感变成可验证的 Codex 项目
tagline_zh: 非技术创作者说一句“我想要个网站”，它就把想法拆成可运行、可交接、可迭代的小项目，并让飞书上的进度永远和代码真相一。
tagline_en: Non-technical creators say “I want a website”—it turns vague ideas into runnable, hand-off-able mini-projects.
desc_en: Turn a creator's vague idea, references, or source material into a small verifiable Codex or Eazo project and keep project truth aligned with Feishu. Use when a non-technical creator needs to start, hand off, iterate, review, or archive a web, interactive, visual, or event project. Do not trigger for isolated one-line questions or simple copy edits.
why_zh: 它不生成一次性答案，而是建立“项目真相层”：把飞书文档当唯一事实源，每次迭代自动对齐。
why_en: It doesn't produce one-off answers—it builds a project truth layer, treating Feishu as the single source of truth, auto-syncing.
